Using the Maclaurin series,

\(e^x\cos(2x)\) has coefficient of \(x^6\) equal to \(13/80\), and

\[
\frac1{1+2x^2}=1-2x^2+4x^4-8x^6+\cdots
\]

So the coefficient \(a_6\) of \(x^6\) in \(f(x)\) is

\[
a_6=\frac{13}{80}+(-2)\left(-\frac{7}{24}\right)+4\left(-\frac32\right)-8
= -\frac{3181}{240}.
\]

Thus

\[
f^{(6)}(0)=6!a_6=720\left(-\frac{3181}{240}\right)=-9543.
\]

ANSWER: -9543
